grammarFocus: 比较结构、数量表达与指代综合；冠词和主谓一致检查。
title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Mixed Figure – Data Understanding and Periodic Retesting
prompt:
The figure below shows the results of a simulated study on data understanding and periodic retesting. The bar chart compares the percentage of correct answers in a data interpretation test across three age groups (18–29, 30–44, 45–60) at two time points: initial test and retest after four weeks. The table shows the number of participants in each age group who took part in both tests.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读图表标题、坐标轴单位、图例及表格中的参与者人数，确保理解数据含义。写作时，概括主要特征并进行比较，不要加入个人观点或原因分析。建议用20分钟完成，写至少150词。
